description: This file contains functions for generating and normalizing Discord thread titles using an AI model, including handling API calls, text processing, and prompt construction.

methods.name: generateThreadTitle
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a concise Discord thread title based on message text and optional channel info, using AI completion models.

methods.name: completeThreadTitle
methods.description: Performs the AI completion request with timeout handling to generate a thread title.

methods.name: buildThreadTitleUserMessage
methods.description: Constructs the user message prompt for the AI model, including channel context and message text.

methods.name: truncateThreadTitleSourceText
methods.description: Truncates the message text to a maximum length for processing.

methods.name: resolveThreadTitleTimeoutMs
methods.description: Determines the timeout duration in milliseconds, defaulting if not provided.

methods.name: normalizeGeneratedThreadTitle
methods.description: Cleans and extracts the first meaningful line from the AI-generated title.

methods.name: stripThreadTitleWrappers
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes, markdown, and formatting wrappers from a raw title string.

methods.name: normalizeTitleContextField
methods.description: Normalizes and truncates channel name or description to fit within character limits.
